description: This Java class 'CredentialsAmqpEndpoint' implements an AMQP endpoint for managing device credentials within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles AMQP messages for the Credentials API by converting them into event bus messages for processing.

classes.name: CredentialsAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A Java class implementing an AMQP endpoint for managing device credentials, extending a request-response endpoint framework, and handling message conversions and filtering for the Credentials API.

methods.name: CredentialsAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.description: Returns the name identifier of this endpoint, as defined by CredentialsConstants.CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the address on the event bus where this service listens for credential requests.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Converts an AMQP message into an EventBusMessage for processing, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification

methods.description: Generates an AMQP reply message based on the processing outcome.
